title: Review of c03's gated FCH micelles (SIBWD): replicated on seed 9 (cargo 27-31x, gate off 1.1x; 22 persistent splits, generation 4, 0 merges)
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. I looked at fission_strips_seed1.png (figure-8 pinch of the shell ring, each daughter closing its own ring) and contrast.txt, then re-ran the claimed world unchanged on new seed 9 (rerun/seed9, T=400) and the beta=0 gate ablation on the same seed (beta0/seed9), and measured cargo contrast with c03's cargo_contrast.py (contrast_*.txt). From white noise (~30 micelles by t=16) the population grows to 61 bodies; labkit finds 30 splits, 22 persistent, max generation 4, 0 merges. Shell q is membrane-like in 239/242 individuals (rim/core 11, rim/outside 4.8). Cargo contrast at frames 60-100: 26.8-30.5x with 100% of bodies >= 2x (weakest body 3.5-16x; the weak ones are fresh daughters, visible as cyan micelles in rerun/seed9/sheet.png); with beta=0 on the same seed: 1.1-1.2x, 0% of bodies >= 2x.

observations.I: rerun/seed9/sheet.png: discrete micelles of fixed size t=16-400
observations.B: rerun/seed9/radial.png: shell q rim/core 11, rim/outside 4.78, 239/242 membrane-like
observations.D: rerun/seed9/lineage.png: 22 persistent splits, max generation 4, 0 merges

verdicts.limitation: One new seed; I did not re-run chi_q=0 or the resolution check. The bodies are filled micelles (no lumen); the shell is a quasi-equilibrium adsorbed layer, and the gate is a designed D exp(-8q) mobility, so W is containment by an imposed gate law on a self-made layer. Daughters leak at the neck and start lower (weakest body 3.5x at t=400). The amphiphile feed is uniform and open, so growth is by construction; no Laplacian-only twin.
